faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Govt VI&HI School Bastar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Govt VI&HI School Bastar Recruitment 2026 is 15th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 11 vacancies are available for various posts including High Class Teacher, Subject Expert, Integrated Teacher, Computer Instructor, Vocational Sewing Instructor, and Part-time Music Teacher.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for all posts is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. Are there any application fees for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the High Class Teacher post?
faq.answer: For the High Class Teacher post (Visually Impaired Category), candidates need to be a Graduate with B.Ed./D.Ed. (VI) and possess RCI Registration.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on merit, calculated from educational percentages. For teaching posts, it's 60% Graduation + 40% B.Ed./M.Ed., and for instructor posts, it's 50% 12th + 50% Diploma.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Government Higher Secondary School for the Visually and Hearing Impaired Bastar (Govt VI&HI School Bastar).

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the organization, which is https://bastar.gov.in.
